title: Workbench bookmark category
description: One named grouping of repository files (<data root>/workbench/bookmarks/<category_id>.json, ADR-029, REQ-012 R09). category_id is an immutable lowercase slug and is also the file name stem; a rename changes name only. entries is an ordered list of unique repository-relative forward-slash paths to files, validated against the working tree on write and resolved to present, missing or excluded on every read; it is never pruned automatically. Private-file entries (under _private/ or any gitignored path) are deliberately unsupported. This schema asserts structural shape only: that category_id equals the file name stem, that the Windows reserved device names are not used as ids, and that name is unique case-insensitively across the data root are asserted by test/test_workbench_bookmarks.py and the routes.
